title: My Quiet Bible · Verenga, namata, govera, dzokorora
description: Verenga, namata, govera, dzokorora. Bhaibheri neshanduro {{versions}} nemitauro {{languages}}, bhatani re🙏 rekunamata zvinonzwika pamusoro pezvamaverenga, nemapoka madiki akavanzika ekugovera minamato yenyu. Mahara, hapana kushambadza, inoshanda pasina Indaneti.
sub: Bhaibheri chete: hapana zvirongwa, hapana nhau dzisingaperi, hapana kushambadza. Mahara, uye inoshanda pasina Indaneti.
hint: Hapana kunyoresa. Inovhurika pano mubhurawuza yenyu.
verseSub:
Shanduro {{versions}} mumitauro {{languages}}, dzose ndedzevanhu vose kana dzine rezinesi rakavhurika.
          Ndima imwe chete, mune dzimwe dzacho:
biblesP: Shanduro {{versions}} mumitauro {{languages}}: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Bhaibheri reChiHebheru neTestamente Itsva reChiGiriki, kanoni yeEtiopia muChirungu, ChiFrench neGe'ez, nezvimwe. Enzanisai kusvika nhanhatu padivi nepadivi.
searchP: Shoko, chirevo, mashoko maviri ari pedyo, muBhaibheri rimwe kana mazhinji, zvawanikwa zvichiverengwa nebhuku. Nyorai ndima uye mavepo. Nhamba dzaStrong futi.
offlineP: Mabhaibheri amunoverenga anosara pafoni yenyu. Mundege, mumakomo, pasi pevhu: inovhurika pandima pamakasiira, pasina kubatana zvachose.
marksP: Mavara masere, chinyorwa pandima kana pachikamu chose, ribhoni renzvimbo dzamunodzokera. Unzai zvamakachengeta mune imwe app yeBhaibheri. Ratidza ndima sepeni inovheneka, kana kuti pendesa mavara ayo.
devicesP: Chete kana muchida. Pindai nepasskey kana nekodhi inotumirwa neemail, uye zvakapendwa, zvinyorwa nemarongero enyu zvinokuteverai. Mudziyo wechipiri unopinda kubva pane wekutanga nelink imwe; hapana chekunyora.
readingP: Mavara matanhatu, rimwe racho rakagadzirirwa vasingaoni zvakanaka. Mavara makuru sezvamunoda, nemabhatani asingapotswe. Svaipai kuti mushandure chitsauko. Chiedza, Sepia kana Rima, sepeji rino.
nots:
• Hapana zvirongwa zvekuverenga. Hapana zvidzidzo zvezuva nezuva. Hapana chakasarudzirwa imi.
  • Hapana kushambadza. Hapana kuteverwa. Hapana macookie.
  • Hapana kubhadhara. Hapana chakakiyiwa.
  • Hapana akaundi inodiwa. Pindai chete kana muchida kuwiriranisa.
free: My Quiet Bible ndeyemahara, uye ichagara yakadaro. Kana ichikubatsirai, munogona kubatsira kuti mwenje urambe uchibvira. Hapana chichazovimba nazvo.
installSub: Ipapo inovhurika pachidzitiro chose seimwe app ipi neipi, inochengeta pamakasvika, uye inoshanda pasina kubatana.
installSubComputer: Ipapo inovhurika muhwindo rayo seimwe app ipi neipi, inochengeta pamakasvika, uye inoshanda pasina kubatana.
iosSteps:
• Vhurai Bhaibheri muSafari.
  • Bayai bhatani remenyu pabhawa rekero, mozoti Share {svg}. PamaiPhone ekare, Share iri ipapo pabhawa rezasi.
  • Bayai View More, mozoti Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Siyai Open as Web App yakavhurwa mobaya Add. Mwenje unoonekwa paHome Screen yenyu.
iosNote: Zviitei muri muBhaibheri, kwete papeji rino, kuti mwenje uvhurike zvakananga pakuverenga kwenyu. Shandisai Safari: mamwe mabhurawuza paiPhone neiPad haagoni nguva dzose kuwedzera app.
orSafari: Kana, pasina App Store, kubva muSafari:
androidNote: Kubaya kamwe chete. Hapana chinopfuura nemuchitoro chemaapp.
androidInstalled: Yaiswa. Vhurai mwenje pamwe nemamwe maapp enyu.
androidSteps:
• Vhurai Bhaibheri muChrome, kana mubhurawuza yamunoshandisa.
  • Vhurai menyu yebhurawuza, kazhinji madoti matatu {svg} kumusoro kurudyi.
  • Bayai Install and create shortcut (mamwe mabhurawuza anoti Add to Home screen).
  • Sarudzai Install, kwete Create shortcut. Mozobaya Install zvakare.
  • Mwenje unoonekwa pamwe nemamwe maapp enyu.
computerNote: Inovhurika muhwindo rayo, seimwe app ipi neipi.
computerInstalled: Yaiswa. Vhurai My Quiet Bible pamwe nemamwe maapp enyu.
computerSteps:
• Vhurai Bhaibheri muChrome kana Edge.
  • Dzvanyai mufananidzo wekuisa kumucheto kurudyi kwebhawa rekero, chidzitiro chine museve {svg}, mozoti Install.
  • PaMac neSafari: dzvanyai Share kumusoro kurudyi, mozoti Add to Dock.
  • Kana chingochengetai tabhu. Inoshanda zvakafanana, uye inorangarira pamakasvika.
footNote: Zvinyorwa zvose ndezvevanhu vose kana zvine rezinesi rakavhurika. Rezinesi reshanduro imwe neimwe rakanyorwa muapp.
shareP: minamato yenyu, kana muchida, nevanhu vashoma vari pedyo nemi.
repeatP: mangwana. Inochengeta pamakasvika, nemazuva enyu akateedzana.
prayLong: Bhatani re🙏 rinogara riripo, padivi pebhawa rekutsvaga. Ribayei motaura munamato wenyu zvinonzwika. Unochengetwa pamwe nendima dzamaiverenga, saka gare gare munogona kuunzwa zvakare uye kuona zvamakanamatira.
prayTicks:
• Hapana chekunyora uye hapana chekugadzirisa.
  • Minamato yenyu inosara pafoni yenyu, kana kuwiriraniswa yakakiyiwa nekiyi yamunayo imi moga.
circlesVerse: “Nokuti apo vaviri kana vatatu vakaungana pamwe chete muzita rangu, ndiripo pakati pavo.”
circlesLong: Kana muchida, gadzirai boka diki remhuri yenyu kana shamwari shoma. Goverai munamato, ndima kana chinyorwa nekubaya kamwe chete. Vanoteerera, vanopindura neshoko, kana kupindura ne🙏, uye mumwe nemumwe anoverenga ndima muBhaibheri rake.
circlesTicks:
• Hazvimbomanikidzwi. Hapana chinobva pafoni yenyu kunze kwekunge mabaya Govera.
  • Boka rimwe nerimwe rine kiyi yaro. Nhengo dzaro chete ndidzo dzinogona kuvhura zviri mariri; kunyange isu hatigoni.
  • Mapoka anoda kupinda mahara, nekiyi yekupinda kana kodhi inotumirwa ne-email.
listenP: Baya ndima, wozoti Teerera. Kana kuti baya Verenga uchitevera pabhawa rekutsvaga, uye shoko rimwe nerimwe rinovheneka richiverengwa. Vaverengi chaivo vanoverenga BSB, King James naLouis Segond. Kwemota, mukicheni, kana maziso aneta.
